model.intro1: We work exclusively with IC Markets and IC Trading, two of the most trusted and regulated brokers in the industry.
model.intro2: When you connect your account and trade using the Expert Advisors on our platform, the broker earns a small fee (called a spread or commission) on every trade. As their partners, a portion of that fee is shared with us and with the EA developers.

bullets.traders: You win because you get access to high-quality, verified Expert Advisors and market-leading infrastructure, without paying for it

model.outro: There are no payments of any kind, and no hidden costs. If you succeed, everyone in the ecosystem benefits, and that's exactly how EasyAlgos was designed to be.
